title: Tell a Weekend Story
description: Put events in order with first, then and in the evening, and tell your own weekend.
can_do: tell a short story in the past with first, then and in the evening.
exit_task: write three sentences about last weekend.

data.heading: Cover your page
data.instruction: Cover your notebook. Write “I was” and “we went” in Czech, both forms for “I”. Then one line from Unit 18: where do you live? (Bydlím v…)

data.heading: Time + person + action
data.body: Start with when, then who did what: Včera jsem… Potom jsme… Večer… The time word comes first and jsem stays second.

data.heading: My sentences
data.instruction: In the My sentences box, write two true sentences about last weekend: one with a process verb, one with a finished one.

items.cz: V sobotu jsem byla na výletě.
items.en: On Saturday I (f.) was on a trip.

items.cz: Včera jsem uvařil večeři a potom jsem četl.
items.en: Yesterday I (m.) cooked dinner and then I read.

data.sentence: Včera jsem ___ do kina a potom jsem ___ večeři.

exercises.prompt: Which verb is the perfective pair of 'psát' (to write)?

data.question_cz: Které sloveso je dokonavý (perfektivní) protějšek slovesa 'psát'?
data.question_en: Which verb is the perfective pair of 'psát' (to write)?
data.explanation: Na- makes psát perfective: napsat (write and finish). Other prefixes change the meaning: popsat = describe.

exercises.prompt: Complete with the perfective verb: 'I read the whole book.' (přečíst)

data.sentence: ___ jsem celou knihu. (přečíst — I read the whole book, completed action)
data.explanation: Přečíst is perfective (finished): přečetl jsem celou knihu. Četl jsem knihu = I was reading a book.

exercises.prompt: Translate to Czech: 'She wrote the letter and sent it.' (both completed actions)

data.source: She wrote the letter and sent it.
accepted_answers: Ona napsala dopis a poslala ho.
data.grammar_note: Both actions are completed → both use perfective past: 'napsala' (napsat) and 'poslala' (poslat, perfective of posílat). Sequence of completed actions = perfective chain. 'Napsala dopis a poslala ho.' — each verb signals a finished step.

data.text_en: Last weekend we had free time. On Friday we were at the theatre, on Saturday we visited Charles Bridge, and on Sunday I stayed home and read a book.
